summary.text: Deb Butler is a Democratic state representative from North Carolina House District 18 in New Hanover County who has served since February 6, 2017, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Butler was born in Columbia, South Carolina, according to Ballotpedia.

She earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville in 1983 and a J.D. from Wake Forest University School of Law in 1986, and her career experience includes working as an attorney.
Butler serves on the House Agriculture and Environment, Finance, Judiciary 2, Transportation and Wildlife Resources committees.
The Democratic primary for her seat in March 2026 was canceled.
